**Compliance Answer: High-risk customers should be subject to enhanced customer due diligence measures and continuous monitoring of business relationships as part of the risk management systems and controls required by regulatory bodies such as FICO (Financial Conduct Authority).**  

**Relevant Regulatory Basis: Revised-Guidance-Note-7A–Implementation of various aspects of the Financial Crime Act.txt, Chunk 11014 and Section 6(a) & (b), FICO Guidelines on Risk Management for Higher Risks**  

**Explanation: According to regulatory guidelines provided in Revised-Guidance-Note-7A–Implementation of various aspects of the Financial Crime Act.txt, Chunk 11014 and Section 6(a) & (b), FICO Guidelines on Risk Management for Higher Risks, institutions are required to develop systems that include customer due diligence measures specifically tailored towards high-risk customers as well as continuous monitoring of business relationships. These mechanisms should be in line with the nature and potential risks associated with these particular clients.**  

**Human Review Required: Yes**
